latestVersion.changelog:
generator-editing-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release enabling easy re-editing and export of AI-generated videos.
- Supports MP4, MOV, WebM, and AVI files up to 500MB.
- Automatic cloud-based editing pipeline — no installation required.
- Simple prompt-based interface for scene reordering, pacing, and quick exporting.
- Built-in session, token, and credits management with clear feedback messages.
